newsitem.title: USA: Brock Intl sees Q2 net loss narrowing.
newsitem.headline: Brock Intl sees Q2 net loss narrowing.

text.p: Brock International Inc said Monday it anticipates increased revenues and a reduced net loss in the second quarter, compared with a net loss of $799,000 on revenues of $3.4 million in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company said it completed its previously announced restructuring during the first quarter.
First Call consensus estimates Brock's net loss will be $0.04 per share in its second quarter ending in June.
The company was not immediately available to discuss its earnings per share or year ago comparisons.
Brock International supplies sales and marketing solutions that help customers optimize revenues and results.
